SAI SUN CITY · LOCATION ATLAS

Ghot, Panvel

The view spans 5.2 km east–west and 4.3 km north–south around Sai Sun City. Distances are straight-line measurements from the Phase I pin.

Location and project

Survey Nos. 33, 61 and 62/1, Village Ghot, Taluka Panvel, District Raigad. The Phase I registration location is 19.088846° N, 73.110424° E. The brochure supplies the tower arrangement. Its placement around the pin is illustrative. Individual tower positions have no surveyed geographic registration.

Developer brochure · Phase I filing coordinates as reported by Square Yards · View pin on Google Maps

Satellite and elevation

Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026. The true-color surface is a local crop of the 10 m Sentinel-2A L2A scene S2A_43QBB_20260319_0_L2A acquired on 19 March 2026. A 129 × 129 grid of bare-earth elevations comes from Mapzen Terrain Tiles. The imagery, terrain and mapped footprints come from different surveys and dates.

Satellite scene record · Mapzen terrain · Terrain source attribution

Mapped features

© OpenStreetMap contributors. The local extract contains 1,560 building footprints, 983 road segments, 44 rail segments and 10 waterways. Actual height or level tags exist for three buildings. All other buildings use illustrative heights. Rail lines under construction are excluded. Coverage reflects what contributors have mapped.

The processed map data are available under the Open Database License 1.0. The map JSON holds source way IDs, height confidence, landmark IDs, and extent. Coordinates are local meters, east and south positive, relative to the pin.
